Every other panel shaped the rules
residuals: none; the eight pins of fuzzy_street_c9/residuals.tsv are closed
rules read: (1) a name of whole numbers only before the suffix ("Twenty One St", "21 Ave", "One Hundred One St"), or a directional before a name that opens with a number and goes on to numbers or ordinals ("E Twenty Third St"), is compared as one string: it matches only at edit similarity 87, as a stored value it reports that similarity, as a candidate against a split street half of it (e1: "300 E Twenty Third Street" finds "300 Twenty Third Street" at 45, the reverse at 89); (2) whole numbers after the street number belong to the number when a word follows ("500 Twenty First Street" finds "500 Twenty Tenth Street" at 80, "500 Twenty Third Street" finds "500 Twenty Second Street" at 75); (3) an ordinal first word is no street number ("3rd Ave", "Third Ave", "101st St" report 88 for themselves)
